description: This file defines the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class, which extends EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI and provides API endpoints related to employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving employee numbers, validating date-time inputs, and checking user permissions for punch actions. The class leverages traits for attendance services, authentication, and number helpers, and interacts with attendance and workflow state management.

classes.description: API class providing functionality for employee attendance records, including date-time validation and permission checks, primarily used within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: isCurrantDateTimeValid
